title: Jet Express
specs: Minors traveling aboard the Jet Express must be accompanied by an adult.
Must be 21 or older to rent golf carts.
The registered Passholder who bought a Season Parking Pass must be present in the vehicle.
Parking passes must be redeemed for a card at the Port Clinton ticket office.
The registered Passholder who bought a Bike Pass must be present with the bike.
Bike passes must be redeemed for a tag that is put on your bike at the dock they are leaving from each time.
The name listed on your credit card must be identical to the contact name listed on your booking.
